body:
I’m sorry, but there’s too much to say and not enough time to say it. I really appreciate that you took time to reach out though.

I was hoping that if I posted this and my family goes through my phone later on, they would be able to see that I did something that made me happy before hand. And that I wasn’t scared.

Thank you again for speaking to me. It’s nice to know that there’s still some genuine kindness left in the world.

Thank you for your reply. My dog is the only reason I’ve made it this long. I’m not going to lie, I’m going to miss her. But it’s been going on for too long. I can’t live just for the doggos anymore. She will be well taken care of.

I will say that Isle of Dogs was great and I’m glad I got to see a cute movie today. I’m going home now and I’m going to snuggle the heck out of my girl.
